text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, come to think of it... Isn't today 
Sir Valentine's Day?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Did you know, Trainer? Ah, you see, I've 
always wanted to play his role at least 
once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. Her greeting was 
completely out of nowhere, but... I've 
gotten completely used to this vibe by 
now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And so, Happy Valentine's Day, 
Trainer-kun! For you—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold the Opera Chocolate Series: "Der 
Freischütz Chocolat" is yours!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There are seven small chocolates inside. 
Six of them are lucky chocolates. And the 
last one...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The last one is the chocolate of 
misfortune! Whoever eats it will be 
cursed! Taste-wise, that is!
choice_data_list: Why did you mix something like that in?
Why did you mix something like that in?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...? Isn't it obvious? It is 
adversity that makes love burn all the 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Overcoming this hardship will only serve 
to elevate your love for me to even 
greater heights!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's a pretty one-sided story, but 
complaining won't change anything now."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin! The splendid tasting 
party for the "Der Freischütz Chocolates"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, pick whichever one you like. 
And then, eat it in one decisive bite!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can't very well turn it down. Taking a 
leap of faith, I pop one into my mouth, 
and—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: H-How is it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, what incredible fortune! To draw the 
lucky chocolate?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So, how is it? How does my homemade-style 
chocolate taste!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Right? Isn't it? Making it look 
homemade was totally worth the effort!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That's good, that's good. Ahaha... Haha...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, it's boring! Boring, I say, 
Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If it ends like this, it won't even be 
much of a show!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Now now, Trainer-kun, here's some seconds 
for you. Go on, have one more."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I keep eating like this, I'll 
eventually end up eating the misfortune 
chocolate. If I complain—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, very well. Then let's do this. We'll 
take turns eating them one by one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about whoever draws the unlucky 
chocolate loses?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I ended up taking turns eating 
chocolate with T.M. Opera O."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch, munch*...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, lucky chocolate again! Phew, talk 
about intense... Now it's your turn.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Do you have something you want 
to say to me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What? Russian roulette? Are you saying 
it's not the 'Magic Marksman Chocolates'?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufu... Kukukuku...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, ah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Freischütz!!!! Chocolate!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us resume. In our bona fide 
game of "Der Freischütz Chocolat"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed neither wanted to back down on 
their settings. So, we peacefully ate 
three chocolates each.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: H-How is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aaah!? Trainer-kun!? Trainer-kuuuuun!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rubbing my stomach, I opened my eyes... 
and found myself in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, so you noticed, Trainer-kun. You 
almost lost your life just now..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... If anything had 
happened to you, I wouldn't know what 
to..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, rest well and sleep. I'll stay right 
here by your side until you've recovered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Opera! Come out, Opera!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: That's right! Without you, I'm...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Good grief, what a noisy bunch...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My fans whom I've kept waiting.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I ended up canceling all my plans while I 
was nursing you back to health, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. There's nothing in this world 
more important to me than you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us lose ourselves in a world for 
just the two of us amidst the hustle and 
bustle, and sing of love at the top of our 
lungs. La la~ la la~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's hard to tell how serious she's 
being, but it seems certain that T.M. 
Opera O was genuinely worried."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was quite a Valentine's mishap. Even 
so... it helped confirm certain feelings.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Speaking of which, I have a 
get-well gift for you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Eat this and cheer up, my friend.
choice_data_list: What did you bring for me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Part 2 of the Opera Chocolate Series: "The 
Betrayed Bride" Chocolat!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I refused with all my might.
